entity: On the Sublime (Περὶ ὕψους, De sublimitate), the Greek treatise of the first century CE ascribed to 'Longinus' (Pseudo-Longinus); transmitted in Parisinus graecus 2036 (tenth or eleventh century) and its apographs, with lacunae
classes_note: No class is configured: the field sources the treatise as 'a Roman-era Greek work of literary criticism' (B1, lead) and 'one of a number of classical literary treatises' (B3), and no archive category is applied in the field to that class; O enters as O-direct only, where an archive sentence that names the treatise applies an archive category to it. The brief's strings are the aliases; 'Longinus' also matches Cassius Longinus, which the reading sets apart as a homonym.
